about: Documents' tools for agents (through Agent Link): name, what it does, its arguments as JSON Schema, its group, whether it changes the document.

drawing_make.description: A drawing sheet of bodies: standard views (front, top, right, iso by default; back, bottom, left too), first-angle (ISO) or third-angle (ASME) projection, at the largest standard scale that fits A4 or A3 (paper auto picks A3 only when it allows a bigger scale), overall sizes dimensioned once each (dimensions: false leaves them off), hidden: true dashes the hidden edges. Writes SVG, PDF and DXF to the output folder and adds a TechDraw page with the same views to the document (page: false leaves it out). dims adds feature dimensions with tolerances or ISO 286 fits (limits written in), holes calls out every round hole by size, titleBlock fills a title block of labelled cells. section: a straight view drawn as a full section (cut square to it through the middle, sectionAt mm towards the viewer; the cut faces hatched, the cutting line lettered sectionLabel, A, in a view that sees it edge on) — for bores, pockets and walls inside.

bodies.description: Bodies to draw; all when left out.

scale.description: 0.5 for 1:2, 2 for 2:1; left out, the largest standard one that fits.

dims.description: Feature dimensions: [{ view, kind: length (a, b, along h|v, offset mm) | diameter | radius (a round edge), fit "H7" or plus/minus mm, label }]; a and b a point [x,y,z] or a query { body, kind, type, radius, near } (a circle's centre, an edge's middle).

holes.description: true: every round hole seen end on in the top view called out by size ("4× ⌀3.4"); or the view's name.

holeFits.description: A fit per hole diameter for the callouts: { "6": "H7" }.

titleBlock.description: { title, partNumber, revision, material, finish, drawnBy, date, checkedBy, company, generalTolerance (ISO 2768-m to start) } — ask the person for theirs.

drawing_make.source: Agent Link for FreeCAD 4ac5a4f (moved to Workshop Documents)

drawing_exploded.description: An assembly manual: steps [{ title, add: [bodies], note }] in the order the parts go together; each step an isometric view (SVG) with the parts already in place and the new ones moved off by explode mm (up over their places, or out from the middle), a trail to where each goes and a balloon with its item number. Writes the steps and <name>_assembly.md with a bill of materials (bodies the same shape are one item, with the material and mass where part_spec recorded one, and how each is made from its setup). A body goes in once.
drawing_exploded.source: Agent Link for FreeCAD 4ac5a4f (moved to Workshop Documents)

patent_figures.description: Patent-style figures FIG. 1 … (iso, front, top, right by default): black line art on A4 within the USPTO's margins, no hidden lines or shading, each part's reference numeral (10, 20, 30 … or numerals { body: n }) with a lead line to a face of it the viewer sees. Writes an SVG and PDF per figure and a list of the numerals. A part hidden behind others in a view gets no numeral there (notSeenIn).

patent_draft.description: A Markdown draft of a patent description and a claims skeleton from the bodies — their sizes, which adjoin which, the numerals and figures of the last patent_figures — marked as a starting point for a patent attorney's review, with what only the inventor and counsel can say left in brackets. Written to the output folder; never filed or sent anywhere.

library_pack.description: Pack bodies to share: a zip of each as STEP and STL (formats), a README with their sizes, material and mass, and the print settings from their print setup (magnet pauses too), a LICENSE (license: CC-BY-4.0, CC-BY-SA-4.0, CC0-1.0 or MIT — ask the person; author is required for all but CC0), and credits [{ title, author, url, license, changes }] for remixed parts, refused when their licence does not allow the one chosen (no-derivatives, non-commercial, share-alike). The STEP header carries the file's name and the author given, no path, user name or organisation.
library_pack.source: Agent Link for FreeCAD 4ac5a4f (moved to Workshop Documents)
